issue: Apply Now appeared briefly after refresh, then disappeared for an ordinary User.
rootCause: A delayed Firestore read of salesStaffApplications/{uid} could return historical status=approved. v1241 treated that old approval as stronger than the current users/{username} role=User and hid the banner about a second after initial render.
fixes: Current Firestore user role is authoritative over historical application status.
If current role is User/member/customer and old application status is approved, banner stays visible and button is Apply Now.
Current Staff/Manager/Admin/Administrator/Owner still hide the banner.
Pending remains Application Pending; rejected remains Reapply.
